title: Lower bound for a nonzero Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, let $g:\{\pm1\}^I\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $S\subseteq I$. If the Fourier coefficient $\widehat g(S)=\mathbb E_x[g(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ is nonzero, then $1/|\{\pm1\}^I|\le |\widehat g(S)|$.
hypotheses_covered: Sign-valued function on the indexed sign cube
